# Requirement
```text
We want to automate the management of a small municipal library. The library has a name and manages a collection of documents and a set of registered members. Members have a first name and a surname. Documents are uniquely identified by their title. Every document has a title. A volume is a kind of document and also has an author. A book is a kind of volume and also has a bookId that identifies the physical or catalogued copy. A dictionary is a kind of volume and also has a dictionaryId that identifies the dictionary entry in the library catalog. A comic is also a kind of volume and has a recipient name. A journal is a kind of document and has a publication date. Only books can be borrowed.
A registered member can borrow or return a book, and the system must always be able to list the titles currently borrowed by that member. A member can hold at most three borrowed books at the same time. When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

@startuml

title municipalLibrary Model

class Book {
    bookId : String
}
class BorrowRecord {
    borrowingDate : Date
    returnDue : Date

    extendDueDate(today : Date) : Date
    isOverdue(today : Date) : boolean
}
class Comic {
    recipientName : String
}
class Dictionary {
    dictionaryId : String
}
abstract class Document {
    title : String
}
class Journal {
    publicationDate : Date
}
class Library {
    name : String
    documents : List<Document>
    members : List<Member>
    addDocument(doc : Document) : void
    registerMember(firstName : String, surname : String) : boolean
}
class Member {
    firstName : String
    surname : String
    borrowRecords : List<BorrowRecord>
    library : Library
    borrowBook(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : boolean
    extendReturnDueDate(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : Date
    listBorrowedBookTitles() : List<String>
    returnBook(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : boolean
}
abstract class Volume {
    author : String
}

Book --|> Volume
BorrowRecord --> Book : book
Comic --|> Volume
Dictionary --|> Volume
Journal --|> Document
Library *-- "*" Document : documents
Library *-- "*" Member : members  'opposite: library
Member *-- "*" BorrowRecord : borrowRecords
Member --> Library : library  'opposite: members
Volume --|> Document
@enduml
```

# Requirement
```text
We want to automate the management of a small municipal library. The library has a name and manages a collection of documents and a set of registered members. Members have a first name and a surname. Documents are uniquely identified by their title. Every document has a title. A volume is a kind of document and also has an author. A book is a kind of volume and also has a bookId that identifies the physical or catalogued copy. A dictionary is a kind of volume and also has a dictionaryId that identifies the dictionary entry in the library catalog. A comic is also a kind of volume and has a recipient name. A journal is a kind of document and has a publication date. Only books can be borrowed.
A registered member can borrow or return a book, and the system must always be able to list the titles currently borrowed by that member. A member can hold at most three borrowed books at the same time. When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

BorrowRecord::extendDueDate
Summary: Extends the return due date of a BorrowRecord by seven days if the request is made on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date. Returns the new due date if extended, otherwise returns the original due date.
Algorithm: 
  if (today is on or after borrowingDate AND today is strictly before returnDue) then
      returnDue = returnDue + 7 days
      return returnDue
  else
      return returnDue (unchanged)
Related Features: returnDue, borrowingDate
Related Classes: None

Output: Date - the (possibly extended) return due date, in format "yyyy-MM-dd". If extended, the new due date is exactly 7 days after the original returnDue; otherwise, the original returnDue is returned.

# Requirement
```text
We want to automate the management of a small municipal library. The library has a name and manages a collection of documents and a set of registered members. Members have a first name and a surname. Documents are uniquely identified by their title. Every document has a title. A volume is a kind of document and also has an author. A book is a kind of volume and also has a bookId that identifies the physical or catalogued copy. A dictionary is a kind of volume and also has a dictionaryId that identifies the dictionary entry in the library catalog. A comic is also a kind of volume and has a recipient name. A journal is a kind of document and has a publication date. Only books can be borrowed.
A registered member can borrow or return a book, and the system must always be able to list the titles currently borrowed by that member. A member can hold at most three borrowed books at the same time. When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

# Operation Specifications
BorrowRecord::isOverdue
Summary: Checks whether the borrowed book is overdue on a given date. Returns true if the given date is strictly after the return due date.
Algorithm: return today > returnDue
Related Features: returnDue
Related Classes: None
Input: today : Date - the date to check against, in format "yyyy-MM-dd". Must be a valid date.
Output: boolean - true if today is strictly after returnDue; false otherwise.
Pre-condition: today is a valid Date object.
Post-condition: Returns true if today > returnDue, false otherwise.

BorrowRecord::extendDueDate
Summary: Extends the return due date of a BorrowRecord by seven days if the request is made on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date. Returns the new due date if extended, otherwise returns the original due date.
Algorithm: 
  if (today is on or after borrowingDate AND today is strictly before returnDue) then
      returnDue = returnDue + 7 days
      return returnDue
  else
      return returnDue (unchanged)
Related Features: returnDue, borrowingDate
Related Classes: None
Input: today : Date - the date of the extension request, in format "yyyy-MM-dd". Must be a valid date.
Output: Date - the (possibly extended) return due date, in format "yyyy-MM-dd". If extended, the new due date is exactly 7 days after the original returnDue; otherwise, the original returnDue is returned.
Pre-condition: today is a valid Date object.
Post-condition: If today is on or after borrowingDate and before returnDue, then returnDue is increased by exactly 7 days. Otherwise, returnDue remains unchanged.

# Operation Specifications
Member::borrowBook
Summary: Attempts to borrow a book from the library by title. The operation succeeds only when: the title exists in the library's documents, the document is a Book, the book is not currently borrowed by any member, and this member currently holds fewer than 3 borrowed books. On success, a BorrowRecord is created with today as borrowingDate and returnDue = today + 7 days, and true is returned. Otherwise, false is returned.
Algorithm:
  // Find document by title in library.documents
  Document doc = findDocumentByTitle(bookTitle)
  if (doc is null OR doc is not instance of Book) then return false
  Book book = (Book) doc
  // Check if book is already borrowed by any member
  for each member in library.members:
      for each record in member.borrowRecords:
          if (record.book == book) then return false
  // Check member's current borrow count
  if (borrowRecords.size() >= 3) then return false
  // Create borrow record
  BorrowRecord record = new BorrowRecord()
  record.borrowingDate = today
  record.returnDue = today + 7 days
  record.book = book
  borrowRecords.add(record)
  return true
Related Features: borrowRecords (List<BorrowRecord>), library (Library), library.documents, library.members
Related Classes: Library, Book, BorrowRecord, Document, Member
Input: bookTitle : String - the title of the book to borrow. Must not be null.
       today : Date - the current date, in format "yyyy-MM-dd". Must be a valid date.
Output: boolean - true if borrowing succeeds; false otherwise.
Pre-condition: bookTitle is not null; today is a valid Date object; this member is already registered in the library.
Post-condition: If true is returned, a new BorrowRecord is added to borrowRecords with borrowingDate = today, returnDue = today + 7 days, and book = the found Book. If false is returned, no changes are made.

Member::returnBook
Summary: Attempts to return a borrowed book identified by title. The operation succeeds only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. On success, the corresponding BorrowRecord is removed and true is returned. If the member does not hold the book, or if the book is overdue, false is returned and no record is removed.
Algorithm:
  // Find the borrow record for the given book title
  BorrowRecord targetRecord = null
  for each record in borrowRecords:
      if (record.book.title.equals(bookTitle)) then
          targetRecord = record
          break
  if (targetRecord is null) then return false
  // Check if overdue
  if (targetRecord.isOverdue(today)) then return false
  // Remove the record
  borrowRecords.remove(targetRecord)
  return true
Related Features: borrowRecords (List<BorrowRecord>)
Related Classes: BorrowRecord, Book
Input: bookTitle : String - the title of the book to return. Must not be null.
       today : Date - the current date, in format "yyyy-MM-dd". Must be a valid date.
Output: boolean - true if the book is successfully returned (record removed); false if the book is not held by this member or is overdue.
Pre-condition: bookTitle is not null; today is a valid Date object.
Post-condition: If true is returned, the BorrowRecord for the given book title is removed from borrowRecords. If false is returned, no changes are made.

Member::listBorrowedBookTitles
Summary: Returns a list of titles of all books currently borrowed by this member. If the member has no active borrowed books, returns an empty list.
Algorithm:
  List<String> titles = new empty list
  for each record in borrowRecords:
      titles.add(record.book.title)
  return titles
Related Features: borrowRecords (List<BorrowRecord>)
Related Classes: BorrowRecord, Book
Input: None
Output: List<String> - a list of book titles currently borrowed by this member. May be empty. Each title is a non-null String.
Pre-condition: None
Post-condition: Returns a list containing the title of every Book referenced by a BorrowRecord in borrowRecords. No changes are made to the system.

Member::extendReturnDueDate
Summary: Requests an extension of the return due date for one of this member's borrowed books, identified by title. Delegates to the corresponding BorrowRecord's extendDueDate method. Returns the new due date if extension is granted, otherwise returns the original due date.
Algorithm:
  for each record in borrowRecords:
      if (record.book.title.equals(bookTitle)) then
          return record.extendDueDate(today)
  // If no such borrowed book found, return today (no change, but this case should not occur per requirements)
  return today
Related Features: borrowRecords (List<BorrowRecord>)
Related Classes: BorrowRecord, Book
Input: bookTitle : String - the title of the borrowed book to extend. Must not be null.
       today : Date - the date of the extension request, in format "yyyy-MM-dd". Must be a valid date.
Output: Date - the (possibly extended) return due date. If extension is granted, it is the original returnDue + 7 days; otherwise, the original returnDue is returned. If the book is not found in this member's borrowRecords, returns today as a fallback.
Pre-condition: bookTitle is not null; today is a valid Date object; the member must have a borrowRecord for the given book title.
Post-condition: If the extension conditions are met (today on or after borrowingDate and strictly before returnDue), the returnDue of the matching BorrowRecord is increased by 7 days. Otherwise, no change.

Summary: Requests an extension of the return due date for one of this member's borrowed books, identified by title. Delegates to the corresponding BorrowRecord's extendDueDate method. Returns the new due date if extension is granted, otherwise returns the original due date.
Algorithm:

          return record.extendDueDate(today)
  // If no such borrowed book found, return today (no change, but this case should not occur per requirements)
  return today
Related Features: borrowRecords (List<BorrowRecord>)
Related Classes: BorrowRecord, Book
Input: bookTitle : String - the title of the borrowed book to extend. Must not be null.
       today : Date - the date of the extension request, in format "yyyy-MM-dd". Must be a valid date.
Output: Date - the (possibly extended) return due date. If extension is granted, it is the original returnDue + 7 days; otherwise, the original returnDue is returned. If the book is not found in this member's borrowRecords, returns today as a fallback.
Pre-condition: bookTitle is not null; today is a valid Date object; the member must have a borrowRecord for the given book title.
Post-condition: If the extension conditions are met (today on or after borrowingDate and strictly before returnDue), the returnDue of the matching BorrowRecord is increased by 7 days. Otherwise, no change.

- To create an EList instance, import and use `org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList`.

- The getter of a boolean attribute `bv` looks like `isBv()`, e.g., `isIsTrue()` for `isTrue`.
- When possibe, use the creation factory for object creation.
- To create an EList instance, import and use `org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList`.

   * Summary: Attempts to borrow a book from the library by title. The operation succeeds only when: the title exists in the library's documents, the document is a Book, the book is not currently borrowed by any member, and this member currently holds fewer than 3 borrowed books. On success, a BorrowRecord is created with today as borrowingDate and returnDue = today + 7 days, and true is returned. Otherwise, false is returned.
   * Algorithm:
   *   // Find document by title in library.documents
   *   Document doc = findDocumentByTitle(bookTitle)
   *   if (doc is null OR doc is not instance of Book) then return false
   *   Book book = (Book) doc
   *   // Check if book is already borrowed by any member
   *   for each member in library.members:
   *       for each record in member.borrowRecords:
   *           if (record.book == book) then return false
   *   // Check member's current borrow count
   *   if (borrowRecords.size() >= 3) then return false
   *   // Create borrow record
   *   BorrowRecord record = new BorrowRecord()
   *   record.borrowingDate = today

  public boolean borrowBook(final String bookTitle, final Date today)
  {
    // Find document by title in library.documents
    Library library = getLibrary();
    Document doc = null;
    for (Document d : library.getDocuments()) {
      if (bookTitle.equals(d.getTitle())) {
        doc = d;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (doc == null || !(doc instanceof Book)) {
      return false;
    }
    Book book = (Book) doc;
    // Check if book is already borrowed by any member
    for (Member member : library.getMembers()) {
      for (BorrowRecord record : member.getBorrowRecords()) {
        if (record.getBook() == book) {
          return false;
        }
      }
    }
    // Check member's current borrow count
    if (getBorrowRecords().size() >= 3) {
      return false;
    }
    // Create borrow record
    BorrowRecord record = MunicipalLibraryFactory.eINSTANCE.createBorrowRecord();
    record.setBorrowingDate(today);
    record.setReturnDue(new Date(today.getTime() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000L));
    record.setBook(book);
    getBorrowRecords().add(record);
    return true;
  }

# Requirement
```text
We want to automate the management of a small municipal library. The library has a name and manages a collection of documents and a set of registered members. Members have a first name and a surname. Documents are uniquely identified by their title. Every document has a title. A volume is a kind of document and also has an author. A book is a kind of volume and also has a bookId that identifies the physical or catalogued copy. A dictionary is a kind of volume and also has a dictionaryId that identifies the dictionary entry in the library catalog. A comic is also a kind of volume and has a recipient name. A journal is a kind of document and has a publication date. Only books can be borrowed.
A registered member can borrow or return a book, and the system must always be able to list the titles currently borrowed by that member. A member can hold at most three borrowed books at the same time. When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

@startuml

class Book {

}
class BorrowRecord {

    returnDue : Date

    isOverdue(today : Date) : boolean
}

    recipientName : String
}

    dictionaryId : String
}
abstract class Document {
    title : String
}
class Journal {
    publicationDate : Date
}
class Library {
    name : String
    documents : List<Document>
    members : List<Member>
    addDocument(doc : Document) : void
    registerMember(firstName : String, surname : String) : boolean
}
class Member {
    firstName : String
    surname : String
    borrowRecords : List<BorrowRecord>
    library : Library
    borrowBook(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : boolean
    extendReturnDueDate(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : Date
    listBorrowedBookTitles() : List<String>
    returnBook(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : boolean
}
abstract class Volume {
    author : String
}

Book --|> Volume
BorrowRecord --> Book : book
Comic --|> Volume
Dictionary --|> Volume
Journal --|> Document
Library *-- "*" Document : documents
Library *-- "*" Member : members  'opposite: library
Member *-- "*" BorrowRecord : borrowRecords
Member --> Library : library  'opposite: members
Volume --|> Document
@enduml
```

Library::addDocument

Algorithm:

Related Features: documents (List<Document>)
Related Classes: Document

Output: void
Pre-condition: doc is not null and not already present in documents (by title uniqueness).
Post-condition: doc is added to the documents list.

Library::registerMember
Summary: Registers a new member with the given first name and surname. Rejects if first name or surname is null, empty, or whitespace-only, or if another member already has the exact same full name.
Algorithm:
  if (firstName == null or firstName.trim().isEmpty() or surname == null or surname.trim().isEmpty()) then
      return false
  if (exists m in members where m.firstName.equals(firstName) and m.surname.equals(surname)) then
      return false
  else
      Member newMember = new Member(firstName, surname, library = this)
      members.add(newMember)
      return true
Related Features: members (List<Member>), name (String)
Related Classes: Member
Input: firstName : String — the member's first name; must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only; surname : String — the member's surname; must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only.
Output: boolean — true if registration succeeds, false otherwise.
Pre-condition: None.
Post-condition: If registration succeeds, a new Member object is created with firstName, surname, library set to this, and an empty borrowRecords list, and added to members. Returns true. Otherwise, returns false and no member is added.

# Requirement
```text
We want to automate the management of a small municipal library. The library has a name and manages a collection of documents and a set of registered members. Members have a first name and a surname. Documents are uniquely identified by their title. Every document has a title. A volume is a kind of document and also has an author. A book is a kind of volume and also has a bookId that identifies the physical or catalogued copy. A dictionary is a kind of volume and also has a dictionaryId that identifies the dictionary entry in the library catalog. A comic is also a kind of volume and has a recipient name. A journal is a kind of document and has a publication date. Only books can be borrowed.
A registered member can borrow or return a book, and the system must always be able to list the titles currently borrowed by that member. A member can hold at most three borrowed books at the same time. When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

# Operation Specifications
BorrowRecord::extendDueDate
Summary: Extends the return due date of this borrow record by seven days if the given date is within the allowed extension window (on or after borrowing date and strictly before current due date). Otherwise, returns the current due date unchanged.
Algorithm:
  if (today >= borrowingDate and today < returnDue) then
      returnDue = returnDue + 7 days
      return returnDue
  else
      return returnDue
Related Features: borrowingDate, returnDue
Related Classes: None
Input: today : Date — the date to check for extension eligibility; format "yyyy-MM-dd"; must be a valid date.
Output: Date — the new due date if extension was granted, otherwise the original due date; format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Pre-condition: today is a valid date.
Post-condition: If today is on or after borrowingDate and strictly before returnDue, then returnDue is incremented by 7 days. Otherwise, returnDue remains unchanged.

BorrowRecord::isOverdue
Summary: Checks whether the borrow record is overdue relative to a given date.
Algorithm:
  return (today > returnDue)
Related Features: returnDue
Related Classes: None
Input: today : Date — the date to check against; format "yyyy-MM-dd"; must be a valid date.
Output: boolean — true if today is strictly after returnDue, false otherwise.
Pre-condition: today is a valid date.
Post-condition: Returns true if today > returnDue, false otherwise.

# Requirement
```text
We want to automate the management of a small municipal library. The library has a name and manages a collection of documents and a set of registered members. Members have a first name and a surname. Documents are uniquely identified by their title. Every document has a title. A volume is a kind of document and also has an author. A book is a kind of volume and also has a bookId that identifies the physical or catalogued copy. A dictionary is a kind of volume and also has a dictionaryId that identifies the dictionary entry in the library catalog. A comic is also a kind of volume and has a recipient name. A journal is a kind of document and has a publication date. Only books can be borrowed.
A registered member can borrow or return a book, and the system must always be able to list the titles currently borrowed by that member. A member can hold at most three borrowed books at the same time. When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

   * Summary: Borrows a book by its title. The request is accepted only when the title exists in the library's documents, the document is a Book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and this member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a BorrowRecord with today's date as borrowingDate and due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.
   * Algorithm:
   *   Document doc = library.documents.stream().filter(d -> d.title.equals(bookTitle)).findFirst().orElse(null)
   *   if (doc == null) then return false
   *   if (doc is not instanceof Book) then return false
   *   Book book = (Book) doc
   *   for each member in library.members:

   *           if (record.book.bookId.equals(book.bookId)) then return false
   *   if (borrowRecords.size() >= 3) then return false
   *   BorrowRecord record = new BorrowRecord()
   *   record.borrowingDate = today
   *   record.returnDue = today + 7 days
   *   record.book = book
   *   borrowRecords.add(record)
   *   return true

Otherwise false is returned and no record is added.

  public boolean borrowBook(final String bookTitle, final Date today)
  {
    Library library = getLibrary();
    if (library == null) return false;
    
    // Find document by title
    Document doc = null;
    for (Document d : library.getDocuments()) {
      if (bookTitle.equals(d.getTitle())) {
        doc = d;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (doc == null) return false;
    if (!(doc instanceof Book)) return false;
    Book book = (Book) doc;
    
    // Check if the book is already borrowed by any member
    for (Member member : library.getMembers()) {
      for (BorrowRecord record : member.getBorrowRecords()) {
        if (book.getBookId().equals(record.getBook().getBookId())) {
          return false;
        }
      }
    }
    
    // Check if this member already holds 3 or more books
    if (getBorrowRecords().size() >= 3) return false;
    
    // Create borrow record
    BorrowRecord record = MunicipalLibraryFactory.eINSTANCE.createBorrowRecord();
    record.setBorrowingDate(today);
    record.setReturnDue(new Date(today.getTime() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000L));
    record.setBook(book);
    
    getBorrowRecords().add(record);
    return true;
  }

  public boolean returnBook(final String bookTitle, final Date today)
  {
    BorrowRecord foundRecord = null;
    for (BorrowRecord record : getBorrowRecords()) {
      if (bookTitle.equals(record.getBook().getTitle())) {
        foundRecord = record;

A successful borrowing creates a BorrowRecord with today's date as borrowingDate and due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.
   * Algorithm:
   *   Document doc = library.documents.stream().filter(d -> d.title.equals(bookTitle)).findFirst().orElse(null)
   *   if (doc == null) then return false
   *   if (doc is not instanceof Book) then return false
   *   Book book = (Book) doc
   *   for each member in library.members:
   *       for each record in member.borrowRecords:
   *           if (record.book.bookId.equals(book.bookId)) then return false
   *   if (borrowRecords.size() >= 3) then return false
   *   BorrowRecord record = new BorrowRecord()
   *   record.borrowingDate = today
   *   record.returnDue = today + 7 days
   *   record.book = book
   *   borrowRecords.add(record)
   *   return true
   * Related Features: library, borrowRecords
   * Related Classes: Library, Document, Book, BorrowRecord, Date
   * Input: bookTitle : String — the title of the book to borrow; must not be null. today : Date — the current date in format "yyyy-MM-dd"; must be a valid date.
   * Output: boolean — true if borrowing succeeds, false otherwise.
   * Pre-condition: today is a valid date; bookTitle is not null.
   * Post-condition: If the title exists, the document is a Book, the book is not currently borrowed by any member, and this member has fewer than 3 borrowRecords, then a new BorrowRecord with borrowingDate = today, returnDue = today + 7 days, and book = the found Book is added to borrowRecords, and true is returned. Otherwise false is returned and no record is added.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model todayDataType="edu.municipalLibrary.Date"
   *        annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public boolean borrowBook(final String bookTitle, final Date today)
  {
    Library library = getLibrary();
    if (library == null) return false;
    
    // Find document by title
    Document doc = null;
    for (Document d : library.getDocuments()) {
      if (bookTitle.equals(d.getTitle())) {
        doc = d;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (doc == null) return false;
    if (!(doc instanceof Book)) return false;
    Book book = (Book) doc;
    
    // Check if the book is already borrowed by any member
    for (Member member : library.getMembers()) {
      for (BorrowRecord record : member.getBorrowRecords()) {
        if (book.getBookId().equals(record.getBook().getBookId())) {
          return false;
        }
      }
    }
    
    // Check if this member already holds 3 or more books
    if (getBorrowRecords().size() >= 3) return false;
    
    // Create borrow record
    BorrowRecord record = MunicipalLibraryFactory.eINSTANCE.createBorrowRecord();
    record.setBorrowingDate(today);
    record.setReturnDue(new Date(today.getTime() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000L));
    record.setBook(book);
    
    getBorrowRecords().add(record);
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue (today > returnDue), the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and returns true.
   * Algorithm:
   *   BorrowRecord foundRecord = null
   *   for each record in borrowRecords:
   *       if (record.book.title.equals(bookTitle)) then
   *           foundRecord = record
   *           break
   *   if (foundRecord == null) then return false
   *   if (today > foundRecord.returnDue) then return false
   *   borrowRecords.remove(foundRecord)
   *   return true
   * Related Features: borrowRecords
   * Related Classes: BorrowRecord, Book, Date
   * Input: bookTitle : String — the title of the book to return; must not be null. today : Date — the current date in format "yyyy-MM-dd"; must be a valid date.
   * Output: boolean — true if return succeeds, false otherwise.
   * Pre-condition: today is a valid date; bookTitle is not null.
   * Post-condition: If the member has a borrow record for the given title and today <= returnDue, then the borrow record is removed from borrowRecords and true is returned. Otherwise false is returned and no record is removed.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model todayDataType="edu.municipalLibrary.Date"
   *        annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public boolean returnBook(final String bookTitle, final Date today)
  {
    BorrowRecord foundRecord = null;
    for (BorrowRecord record : getBorrowRecords()) {
      if (bookTitle.equals(record.getBook().getTitle())) {
        foundRecord = record;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (foundRecord == null) return false;
    if (today.after(foundRecord.getReturnDue())) return false;
    getBorrowRecords().remove(foundRecord);
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Extends the due date of the borrow record for the given book title by seven days if today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date. Otherwise, returns the current due date unchanged.
   * Algorithm:
   *   for each record in borrowRecords:
   *       if (record.book.title.equals(bookTitle)) then
   *           if (today >= record.borrowingDate and today < record.returnDue) then
   *               record.returnDue = record.returnDue + 7 days
   *               return record.returnDue
   *           else
   *               return record.returnDue
   *   return null  // book not found in borrow records
   * Related Features: borrowRecords
   * Related Classes: BorrowRecord, Book, Date
   * Input: bookTitle : String — the title of the borrowed book to extend; must not be null. today : Date — the current date in format "yyyy-MM-dd"; must be a valid date.
   * Output: Date — the new due date if extension was granted, otherwise the original due date; format "yyyy-MM-dd". Returns null if the member does not hold a borrow record for that title.
   * Pre-condition: today is a valid date; bookTitle is not null.
   * Post-condition: If a borrow record for the given title exists and today is on or after borrowingDate and strictly before returnDue, then returnDue is incremented by 7 days and the new date is returned. Otherwise the original returnDue is returned. If no such record exists, null is returned.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model dataType="edu.municipalLibrary.Date" todayDataType="edu.municipalLibrary.Date"
   *        annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public Date extendReturnDueDate(final String bookTitle, final Date today)
  {
    for (BorrowRecord record : getBorrowRecords()) {
      if (bookTitle.equals(record.getBook().getTitle())) {
        if ((today.equals(record.getBorrowingDate()) || today.after(record.getBorrowingDate())) && today.before(record.getReturnDue())) {
          record.setReturnDue(new Date(record.getReturnDue().getTime() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000L));
          return record.getReturnDue();
        } else {
          return record.getReturnDue();
        }
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  public EList<String> listBorrowedBookTitles()
